observations.title: QA-DISCOVERY-009 versioned point-in-polygon mapping absent before F24
observations.environment: Independent static source review; developer owner corroborated, not dynamic native evidence
steps: Engineering data-command contract areaCode requires verified coordinates and versioned polygon with deterministic boundary ordering.
VenueService.confirmVerified passes placeId only; PostgresVenueReferences.findOrCreate inserts unknown unconditionally.
No point/polygon mapper or injectible dataset in production source tree; no local overlap/boundary implementation.
Owner acknowledged missing local algorithm and took F24; actual licensed London dataset remains separate G-PLACES gate.
